145: For Ted, prom night went about as bad as it’s possible for any night to go. Thirteen years later, he finally gets another chance with his old prom date, only to run up against other suitors including the sleazy detective he hired to find her.
401: This is not a film about gun control. It is a film about the fearful heart and soul of the United States, and the 280 million Americans lucky enough to have the right to a constitutionally protected Uzi. From a look at the Columbine High School security camera tapes to the home of Oscar-winning NRA President Charlton Heston, from a young man who makes homemade napalm with The Anarchist's Cookbook to the murder of a six-year-old girl by another six-year-old. Bowling for Columbine is a journey through the US, through our past, hoping to discover why our pursuit of happiness is so riddled with violence.
Are we a nation of gun nuts or are we just nuts?
Self - Mayor of Sarnia, Ontario, Canada
657: As America's stock of athletic young men is depleted during World War II, a professional all-female baseball league springs up in the Midwest, funded by publicity-hungry candy maker Walter Harvey. Competitive sisters Dottie Hinson and Kit Keller spar with each other, scout Ernie Capadino and grumpy has-been coach Jimmy Dugan on their way to fame.
Once in a lifetime you get a chance to do something different.
913: An unexpected meeting on a train leads two travelers to spend an evening wandering through Vienna. As the night unfolds, they share stories and conversations about life and love, exploring new ideas while a quiet intimacy grows between them, knowing it may be their only night together.
Can the greatest romance of your life last only one night?
1169: When she learns she's in danger of losing her visa status and being deported, overbearing book editor Margaret Tate forces her put-upon assistant, Andrew Paxton, to marry her.
1425: An unknown middle-aged batter named Roy Hobbs with a mysterious past appears out of nowhere to take a losing 1930s baseball team to the top of the league.
He lived for a dream that wouldn't die.
1681: A departing professor gathers his closest colleagues for an intimate farewell, but the night takes an unexpected turn when he shares a stunning secret about his past. From one of the acclaimed writers of Star Trek and The Twilight Zone comes a story that transcends both time and space...
1937: Jesse becomes reunited with Willy three years after the whale's jump to freedom as the teenager tries to rescue the killer whale and other orcas from an oil spill.
The adventure is back. The fun is back. Willy's back. And this time he's brought his whole family to meet an old friend ... and take on a new challenge.
2193: A couple's attitudes are challenged when their daughter brings home a fiancé who is black.
2449: Jim Morris never made it out of the minor leagues before a shoulder injury ended his pitching career twelve years ago. Sometimes dreams come back to life.
2705: Senator Walter Chalmers is aiming to take down mob boss Pete Ross with the help of testimony from the criminal's hothead brother Johnny, who is in protective custody in San Francisco under the watch of police lieutenant Frank Bullitt. The word 'cop' isn't written all over him—something more puzzling is.
2961: A group of maverick scientists on a remote Australian sheep farm are the globe's only hope for obtaining the epic images of man's first steps on the moon.
Man's first step on the moon nearly stumbled on earth.
3217: A neurotic, twice-divorced sci-fi writer moves back in with his mother to solve his personal problems.
3473: Rachel Watson, devastated by her recent divorce, spends her daily commute fantasizing about the seemingly perfect couple who live in a house that her train passes every day, until one morning she sees something shocking happen there and becomes entangled in the mystery that unfolds.
What you see can hurt you.
3729: Disenchanted with the movie industry, Chili Palmer tries the music industry, meeting and romancing a widow of a music executive along the way.
Everyone is looking for the next big hit.
3985: After her werewolf lover unexpectedly dies in an accident, a woman must find a way to raise the son and daughter that she had with him. However, their inheritance of their father's traits prove to be a challenge for her.
One mother, two worlds, endless sacrifice...
4241: Three sailors wreak havoc as they search for love during a whirlwind 24-hour leave in New York City.
They Paint The Town With Joy!

5009: Ms. Isabel Archer isn't afraid to challenge societal norms. Impressed by her free spirit, her kindhearted cousin writes her into his fatally ill father's will. It's going to be a shot in the dark!
5521: A Los Angeles journalist befriends a homeless Juilliard-trained musician, while looking for a new article for the paper.
Life has a mind of its own
5777: A series of mysterious crimes threatens the existence of a new radio network.
At station WBN, the hits just keep on coming.
6033: A group of dancers congregate on the stage of a Broadway theatre to audition for a new musical production directed by Zach. 6289: A wily slave must unite a virgin courtesan and his young smitten master to earn his freedom.

From the four winds they came, the four brothers, their eyes smoking and their fingers itching...

Banker / Reporter / Pickup Artist / Bearded Drag (as Connie Brooks)

Academy Award Winner Friz Freleng's Greatest Warner Bros. Comedy Classics Plus All New Cartoons For the Big Screen.

Bugs Bunny / King Arthur / Sir Osis of Liver / Sir Loin of Beef / Yosemite Sam / Gerry the Idgit Dragon / Daffy Duck / Sylvester / Tweety Pie / Porky Pig / Speedy Gonzales / Treasury Director / Rocky / Mugsy / Judge / Clancy / O'Hara / Cops / Pepe Le Pew / Clarence (B.A. Bird) (voice)
Singing Narrator / Big Bad Wolf / Three Little Pigs (voice)
7313: Joe Slovak is a brilliant first-year med student whose casual, nonconforming approach to life gets tested when he enrolls in Gross Anatomy, the toughest course in med school.
No one thought a real rebel like Joe would make it through medical school. But they didn't know Joe.
7569: We do not know when and how we will die. Death Row inmates do. Werner Herzog embarks on a dialogue with Death Row inmates, asks questions about life and death and looks deep into these individuals, their stories, their crimes.
A gaze into the abyss of the human soul.
Self - Death House Chaplin (as The Reverend Richard Lopez)
Self - Daughter and Sister to Victims
7825: An inside look into one night in the San Francisco underground rave scene.
8337: After escaping Russia's communist revolution, Léon Theremin travels to New York, where he pioneers the field of electronic music with his synthesizer. But at the height of his popularity, Soviet agents kidnap and force him to develop spy technology.
Self – Inventor of the Moog Synthesizer

All the shades of friendship. Including betrayal and revenge.

Married and in love... with a man she didn't know or want!
10129: Just outside of the Malian city of Timbuktu, now occupied by militant Islamic rebels who impose the Sharia on civilians and inconvenience their daily life, a cattleman kills a fisherman.

10641: After a martini-induced rampage, a fantasy-prone young woman is placed under house arrest.
She'd get out more if it wasn't a felony.

How might life be better with less?

His name is Deth. He hunts Trancers. Even in the 20th Century.

TOGETHER AGAIN!...in the BEST and FUNNIEST 'Road' Picture Yet!
12433: Ronnie runs a Disco walking tour with his son, Brayden. When a sexy woman takes the tour, it begins a competition between father and son for her love. It also signals the arrival of an oily strangler who stalks the streets at night.

Sightings are never a coincidence. The cover-up ends here.

On her lonesome lips a smile.

14993: A blind sculptor kidnaps an artists' model and imprisons her in his warehouse studio – a shadowland of perverse monuments to the female form. Here a deranged passion play of sensual and sexual obsession is acted out in world where sight is replaced by touch.
15249: Ace assassin Frank Kitchen is double crossed by gangsters and falls into the hands of rogue surgeon known as The Doctor who turns him into a woman. The hitman, now a hitwoman, sets out for revenge, aided by a nurse named Johnnie who also has secrets.

The Valachi Papers. Fact not Fiction.

18321: An isolated sculptor is visited by his three sons just before the start of WWII.
How long has it been since you've seen a really good movie? If it's been too long then see "Islands in the Stream."
18577: Straight-laced nerd Alistair moves into a college dorm with hardcore marijuana users, who order an old giant bong that proves to have strange magical powers, which sends people to a bizarre drugged-out alternate realm from which there is no easy escape.

The robbery nobody thought could happen by the guys nobody thought could pull it off.
19089: This documentary follows a team of local archaeologists excavating never before explored passageways, shafts, and tombs, piecing together the secrets of Egypt’s most significant find in almost 50 years in Saqqara.

The first independent film to have successfully licensed original Beatles recordings.

Astsubay Kademeli Kıdemli Başçavuş Mustafa Şahin

It is a masterpiece in the cinema of war.
21393: Prague, Bohemia, 1820. Balduin, a penniless student, falls in love with Countess Margit, a wealthy noblewoman whom he has saved from drowning.
Baron Waldis-Schwarzenberg - Margit's Cousin and Fiancé

Akhanda Rudra Sikandar Aghora / Murali Krishna

25745: An American family fulfills their dream of moving back to their roots after inheriting a remote cabin in the mountains of Norway. But there's a surprise waiting for them.
26001: A young woman faces her darkest fears with seven other unwilling participants in a deadly game — a game that can only have one winner.

Before they make the hit, these gangsters shoot the sh!t

She steals a big black dog that belongs to a young man on the run...

Will you win, Godzilla? Will you win, Kong? The battle of the century!
General of the JSDF Eastern Army

32145: Kidnappers force a young mother to recover money stolen by her shady husband.
What she doesn't know could kill her.

EXORCISM! The one last hope for the possessed … But this time the devil wins!
